High pressure centred close to northeast Scotland extends a ridge covering much of Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5 occasionally reaching force 6 in the south this morning, then increasing 5 or 6 occasionally 7 this evening and overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Easterly 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

##Weather##

Fair, isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
